S. Rajamouli - a high-profile media event. (6) INTERNATIONAL CREDENTIALS - FRCS, Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh; PhD in Transplantation, University of Sunderland, England (2010); MS General Surgery PGIMER Chandigarh (2004); DNB (General Surgery), National Board of Examinations; MBBS JIPMER Pondicherry (1997).
